61/G.goal: Explain how Unity's graphics, physics, animation, and audio systems support the practical construction of an XR application.
61/G.achieves: Gives the learner a concrete Unity-based foundation for understanding and implementing an XR system, serving the course's aim of building XR applications with confidence.

61/O1.goal: Describe how Unity's graphics development environment creates and renders XR scenes.
61/O1.achieves: Lets the learner configure render pipelines, scene assets, lighting and effects, and platform graphics backends when implementing the course's XR case study.

61/O2.goal: Explain how Unity's physics engine simulates realistic motion in XR scenes.
61/O2.achieves: Lets the learner apply rigid bodies, colliders, joints, and articulations to build believable object behavior in an XR system.

61/O3.goal: Explain how Unity's animation and audio components support immersive XR experiences.
61/O3.achieves: Lets the learner integrate character animation and audio playback to strengthen presence when developing an XR system.
